description: Canonical structure for the machine-readable entity map produced by Entity Research. Downstream skills (n-gram-table, ros-template, client-ros, topic-planner, virality-research, SEO topical maps) read this shape. If a field is added/renamed/reordered, edit this schema first, then update the skill prose. Bump `version` and append to `version_history` on every change.

version_history.change: Initial schema. Captures: practice_area, scope, location, entities (with three-attribute scoring + tier + cluster ref + bridge flag), clusters (contextual layers), bridge_entities, localization (coverage metric + optional supplement block), metadata (provenance).

PATCH (non-breaking, descriptions only) - three-field geo model alignment (Gabe directive, Whalen scoping). Enriched `scope` and `location` descriptions to note the map is built at the Optimization scope (show anchor) and that its scope/location value IS that anchor; per-episode Episode geo target research reuses/derives from the matching location-scoped map rather than rebuilding it. No field shape change.

practice_area.description: Title-cased practice area name (e.g., 'Car Accidents'). Matches the {Practice Area} Drive folder under templates [master]/AEO/Podcast/Entity Research/.

scope.description: Which scope this map was generated at. Geo model: a Location/Extension map is built at the show's Optimization scope (show anchor) - Topic Only is the jurisdiction-agnostic foundation. Per-episode Episode geo target research reuses/derives from the matching location-scoped map, it does not rebuild it.

location.required: conditional - required when scope is Location or Extension
location.description: State-prefixed jurisdictional folder name (e.g., 'CA - Long Beach'). Format defined in the canonical Podcast Drive doc. Geo model: this value IS the Optimization scope (show anchor) the map is built at - City / State / County / Regional. It is not necessarily any single episode's Episode geo target; anchor scope != per-episode target.

entities.description: Scored entities. Per Best Practices > Target counts: 40-50 total across three tiers.

name.description: Display name (Title Case for proper nouns; sentence case for concepts).

type.description: Entity type category per Best Practices > Entity types (legal-concept / statute / agency / insurance-concept / medical-term / case-type / liable-party / evidence-type / damages-category / cause-of-injury / industry-practice / professional-credential).

prominence.description: How central the entity is to the contextual domain. Weighted highest in vector_strength.

relatedness.description: How strongly the entity connects to the core topic and to other entities.

popularity.description: How often the entity appears across the domain's competitive corpus.

vector_strength.description: Composite score: (prominence × 0.45) + (relatedness × 0.35) + (popularity × 0.20). Per Best Practices > Vector strength formula.

tier.description: Tier assignment per Best Practices > Tier structure. T1 ≥ 0.80, T2 0.60-0.79, T3 0.40-0.59.

is_bridge.description: True if this entity spans ≥2 clusters per Best Practices > Bridge entities.

is_jurisdictional.description: True if the entity is jurisdictional-named (e.g., 'Houston Police Department (HPD)'); false if generic (e.g., 'Police Department'). Used to compute localization coverage.

source.description: Provenance: content-gap citation, parent-map inheritance, or LLM domain knowledge only.

connection_graph.description: Graph layer over entities - clusters and bridges.

clusters.description: 8-15 clusters keyed by cluster_id. Per Best Practices > Clusters - one per contextual layer of the practice area.

contextual_layer_description.description: What contextual slice of the practice area this cluster represents.

entities.description: List of entity ids assigned to this cluster.

bridge_callouts.description: Entity ids in this cluster that are also bridges - flagged for downstream visibility.

bridge_entities.description: 4-6 bridges per Best Practices > Bridge entities. These span ≥2 clusters and carry the highest authority value because they are where the topical graph reconverges.

connection_count.description: How many cross-cluster connections this entity has. Used to rank bridges.

localization.description: Localization metrics + optional supplement. Required field, but the supplement block is null unless the inline-ask was triggered AND user opted in.

coverage_pct.description: Percentage of entities that are jurisdictional-named. Computed as: (entities where is_jurisdictional=true) / total_entities × 100.

threshold_triggered.description: True if generic% > 30 AND scope is City/Extension/tight-county/region. When true, the inline-ask was shown to the user.

supplement_status.description: Tracks the inline-ask outcome: not triggered, triggered but user skipped, or triggered and supplement was rendered.

localization_supplement.description: Optional supplement entities - hyper-focused local entities surfaced via additional research when the threshold triggered AND user opted in. Same item_shape as `entities`. Null otherwise.

metadata.description: Provenance and run-level metadata. Internal-only; not consumed downstream as data, but useful for audit.

version.description: Schema version used to produce this map (mirrors version field at top of this schema doc).

sources_unavailable.description: Which sources were attempted but unavailable (e.g., 'content-gap-report: unavailable').

references_status.description: Whether references/examples/ had calibration anchors at run time.
